name: WatchIntervals

dataInventory.reason: The Android V2 client stages plans, plan-library metadata and immutable workout summaries into an encrypted outbox; Worker staging and Phone Keystore bootstrap are verified, while Watch/PC-off evidence remains missing.
Raw telemetry, routes and sleep details are excluded from cloud sync by default.

knownGaps: Android Keystore recovery/approval sharing, Watch-side Keystore, Doze/boot recovery and second-device conflict/tombstone behavior need real-device validation.
Central signed authority verification, a real Watch and three PC-off rounds are missing; supportsPcOff and supportsBidirectionalDelta therefore remain false.
